findings.text: the declared whole-wall negative control did not leave the 1.10 bound: restoring the per-read whole-wall containment over every cell stationary point read 0.227647 at 2616 cells in job 1276057 with the positive controls passing, so the literal done-when clause that the declared control be observed to leave the bound is unmet and completion rests on the coordinator-authorized substituted deduplication control at 17.178114 in job 1276069; both controls are retained with passes keyed on the substitution and the plan record states the substitution plainly, but a reader of the done-when alone sees a clause met by authorization rather than by the letter.

two of the three cross-process raw ratios exceed ten percent (1.1024828 and 1.1020015 against 0.99232), so the reference arm the headline ratio divides by carries roughly ten percent cross-process spread; the receipt retains the measurements and the qualification rather than smoothing them.

item_verdicts.diff: Sound. The source change adds per-cell wall interiority computed once at construction, bounds the boundary-adjacent wall tests in full-width batches, and replaces the capacity-conditioned deduplication with a while_loop whose trip count follows admitted roots; a diffstat of the tested revision against the reviewed head is docs-only, so the source and test blobs delivered equal the ones measured.
item_verdicts.done_when: Met in the coordinator-authorized substituted form, with one clause retained as a finding. The reduction, the cost receipt keyed on the substituted control, both control logs, the byte-identical source restoration check, the CPU lane with zero added failure ids, the device arm and the plan and anchor records are present; the literal clause that the declared whole-wall control be observed to leave the bound is not met (0.227647x at 2616 cells) and is retained in the receipt as the finding that containment is not the cost carrier, authorized in the resume advice before the substituted arm ran.
item_verdicts.goal: Met. The production read's cost left the 1.10 bound on all three rungs - 0.121676x, 0.133523x and 0.187746x of the pre-adoption cost at 550, 1074 and 2616 cells - while the admission regressions stayed green: the ladder realised 132, 340 and 550 cells, the raster compared 646 cells with zero differing, and the bank replayed 12 of 12 rows with zero differing.
item_verdicts.manifest: Complete and checkable. The reviewed manifest carries status complete, four commits ending at the reviewed head, eight changed paths, both suite JSONs with identical failure-id sets and added_failure_ids none, eleven test log paths, both control logs, and gate fields naming the cost receipt run.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Respected. The eight changed paths are the production file, the one admission test file, this plan's figure directory, the plan and the shared evidence anchor; the two code paths are nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py and tests/test_null_generator_admission.py, and no path under another node's fence appears in the diff.

justifications.durability: The receipt, both control logs, the gate log and the four figure artefacts are on disk under the reports and figure fences, and the landing is recorded in the plan and the evidence anchor; the two weaknesses are that the substituted control's mutation was process-local, so its evidence is the log plus the recorded sha256 restoration rather than a re-runnable artefact, and that the raw reference arm's cross-process spread is about ten percent.
justifications.evidence: The receipt is schema-tagged JSON carrying the gate command, exit status and log path; the CPU lane is compared against a base revision with identical failure ids and zero added ids (180 passed against 178, one unchanged failure, five skipped); the substituted control ran as its own sbatch arm with per-arm subprocess exit statuses, per-sample arrays and SUBSTITUTED_RATIOS, and the source-restoration block records sha256 equality for the four source and test files before and after the mutation, so the delivered blobs are the measured ones.
justifications.fit: Matches the plan contract: the reduction bounds exactly the reads the plan identified as the adoption's cost, both controls are recorded in the receipt under the plan's evidence conventions, and the section and driving-followup closure are left coordinator-owned.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The reduction lands in the operator the plan named and leaves the admission rule untouched: walls admit exactly the roots they admitted before, and the adoption cost falls from 3.377x, 6.299x and 17.236x over pre-adoption to 0.121676x, 0.133523x and 0.187746x at 3 550, 1074 and 2616 cells, inside the bound with room to spare; the dock is one done-when clause carried by substitution rather than by the declared control.
justifications.scope_discipline: Eight declared paths only - the operator, its one admission test file, this plan's figure directory, the plan and the shared evidence anchor - with source confined to forward_operator.py and tests/test_null_generator_admission.py; the one departure from the literal done-when was authorized on the record before it was taken rather than silently re-scoped.
